MapContext.removeMarkers(Object object)

Remove marker

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
markerIds Array Yes a set of marker IDs
success Function No Callback function for successful interface invoking
fail Function No Callback function that fails to be invoked.
complete Function No Callback function that ends the interface invoking. (This function is executed when the interface is successfully invoked or fails to be invoked.)

Sample Code

//maml
<button bindtap="removeMarkers">removeMarkers</button>

//js
Page({
  data: {
    markers: [
      {
        id: 0,
        title: 'marker0',
        latitude: 31.984686,
        longitude: 118.574979,
        width: 10,
        height: 15,
        anchor: { x: 0.5, y: 0.5 },
      },
    ]
  },

  removeMarkers() {
    this.mapContext.removeMarkers({
      markerIds: [0],
      success(res) {
        ma.showModal({
          content: res.errMsg,
        });
      },
      fail(res) {
        ma.showModal({
          content: res.errMsg,
        });
      },
    });
  },
});
